en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.39:
Tleilaxu Instinct
+1 for each Tleilaxu card you acquired
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.40:
Bene Tleilax Alliance
+2 for each step you took on the Tleilaxu track
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.41:
Subversive Techniques
+1 for each specimen you spent to pay for costs other than acquiring Tleilaxu cards
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.42:
Specimen Acquisitions
+1 for each specimen you spent acquiring Tleilaxu cards
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.43:
Rule of Three
+3 for each of the following resources you had exactly three of at the end of the game: spice, Solari, specimens, water
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.40:
Ixian Intrigue
Each player starts with two random Rise of Ix Intrigue cards.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.41:
Spaceport Access
Each player starts with a Spaceport Tech.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.42:
Tick Tock
Each player starts with a Detonation Devices Tech.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.43:
Take a Seat
Each player starts with a Restricted Ordnance Tech.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.44:
Rapid Bombardment
Each player starts with an Artillery Tech.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.45:
Infiltration
Whenever a player sends an Agent to a board space occupied by an enemy Agent, they draw a card.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.46:
Dominion's Reach
Whenever a player takes a Reveal turn, they gain an additional for each board space they control.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.47:
The Spice Must Flow
Each player starts with a Control the Spice instead of a Dune, the Desert Planet.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.48:
Blades for Hire
Each player starts with a Bounty Hunter instead of a Reconnaissance.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.49:
Diplomatic Assembly
Each player starts with a CHOAM Delegate instead of a Dune, the Desert Planet.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.50:
Trade Expansion
Each player starts with a Freighter Fleet instead of a Dune, the Desert Planet.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.51:
Ixian Contacts
Each player starts with a random 4-cost Rise of Ix card in their deck.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.52:
Children of Ix
Players may only choose Rise of Ix Leaders this game.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.53:
Deadly Alliance
The first player to gain an Alliance acquires a Full-Scale Assault to the bottom of their deck (they do not gain its acquire effect).
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.54:
Intimidating Force
Whenever a player deploys a dreadnought, they force each opponent to retreat a troop.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.55:
Echoes of the Voice
At the start of each round, a random board space is blocked by "The Voice" for the entire round.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.56:
Desperate Measures
Whenever a player takes a Reveal turn, they discard the top card of their deck, then gain equal to its cost.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.57:
The Weirding Way
Players take two turns in a row this game.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.58:
Occupation Agenda
The Spice Must Flow is replaced with Occupation.
When a player acquires Occupation, they take control of a board space of their choice.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.59:
Cutting Edge
Combat cards are removed from the Intrigue deck.
Whenever a player acquires a card with at least 1 in its Reveal box, they draw a Combat Intrigue card.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.60:
Corrupted Hall
Hall of Oratory gives a in addition to its other rewards.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.61:
Genetic Breakthrough
While a player has, they may put Imperium cards they acquire on top of their deck.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.62:
Enhanced Atomics
When using Family Atomics, players gain for each card with cost or less removed from the Imperium Row.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.63:
Dueling Labs
You start with a Dissecting Kit in your deck.
Opponents start with Bene Tleilax Lab and .
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.64:
Backchannels
You start with Corrupt Smuggler and Sardaukar Quartermaster on the bottom of your deck.
Opponents start with a seat on the High Council.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.65:
Twisted Agents
You start with two Twisted Mentats, but one fewer Agent.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.66:
Face Dancing Initiation
You start with Face Dancer Initiate instead of Diplomacy.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.67:
Undiplomatic Experiments
You start with Bene Tleilax Researcher instead of Diplomacy.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.68:
Chaotic Lab
The locations of the rewards on the research track are mixed up.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.69:
R&D
Each player starts with a Scientific Breakthrough instead of an Experimentation.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.70:
Genomic Sequencing
You start with Vicious Talents, Tleilaxu Puppet, and Disguised Bureaucrat. You can’t acquire any other Intrigue cards.
Opponents start with two Intrigue cards.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.71:
Wealth Over Water
You start with Economic Positioning, but no .
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.72:
Harvest Protocol
You start with Harvest Cells, but two fewer troops in your garrison.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.73:
Introduction to Immortality
Double the number of Immortality cards in the Imperium deck.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.74:
First Strike
When a player becomes the first player, they draw an Immortality Intrigue card.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.75:
Favored Contact
At the start of your first turn, acquire either Maker Keeper or Wheels Within Wheels.\nEach opponent acquires the card you did not choose.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.76:
After the Fall
After the Shield Wall is destroyed, players acquire cards to the top of their decks instead of their discard piles.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.77:
Kickback
When a player sends an Agent to a board space another player has an open contract for, the contract holder(s) gain .
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.79:
Always Prepared
Each player always has the Intrigue card Strategic Stockpiling.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.81:
Cutpurse
Whenever you place a Spy, take from each opponent who has an Agent on a board space it's spying on (if able).\nOpponents start with .
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.82:
Council Connections
When a player takes their seat on the High Council, they gain Maker Hooks. If they would gain Maker Hooks while already having them, they recruit 1 troop instead.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.83:
Contract Bonus
Whenever a player completes a contract, they gain .
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.84:
Tremor Panic
The first time a sandworm is summoned each round, all opponents of that player must each retreat 1 troop from the conflict.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.85:
Prime Intel
Whenever a player infiltrates using a Spy, they draw a card.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.86:
Slow Burn
Players do not score for matching 2 battle icons. Instead, they score for matching 3 battle icons.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.87:
Ancestor’s Favor
After setting up the Imperium Row, add all Imperium cards costing or more from the base game to the Imperium deck.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.88:
Cataclysm
When the Shield Wall is destroyed, every player loses all of their , , and .
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.89:
Loose Alliance
Whenever a player reaches 3 Influence with a Faction where another player holds the Alliance, they acquire a random card of that Faction with cost 3 or greater to their hand.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.rulesmodifier.90:
Smuggler's Path
You have no Leader and start with Cargo Runner instead of a Signet Ring.
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.44:
Bounty Hunting
+1 for each contract you completed
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.45:
Timed Contract
+3 for each contract you completed while you were the First Player
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.47:
Eyes of the Sisterhood
+3 for each Spy you recalled in a round where you played a Bene Gesserit card
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.48:
Sardaukar Supremacy
+3 for each Conflict you won in a round where you played an Emperor card
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.49:
Maker’s Strike
+2 for each Conflict you won using a sandworm
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.50:
Wormrider
+2 for each time you summoned a sandworm in a round where you played a Fremen card
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.51:
Threads of War
+2 for each set of battle icons you completed
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.52:
Surveillance Network
+1 for each round you ended with two or more Spies
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.54:
Spice Harvesting
+1 for each time you sent an Agent to a Maker space while you had Maker Hooks
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.55:
Guild Navigator
+3 for each time you discarded a Spacing Guild card
en_US.prompt.skirmish.scoringmethods.56:
Council Representative
+4 for each complete set of the 4 Factions in your deck.\nA Multi-faction cards count as each of their Factions.
en_US.scenario.IntroductiontoIx.name: Introduction to Ix
en_US.scenario.IntroductiontoIx.flavor: The desert isn't kind to equipment.
en_US.scenario.IntroductiontoIx.normal.descrip: The Intrigue and Imperium decks contain double the number of Rise of Ix cards. Players may only choose Rise of Ix Leaders.
en_US.scenario.IntroductiontoIx.heroic.descrip: The Intrigue and Imperium decks contain double the number of Rise of Ix cards. Players may only choose Rise of Ix Leaders. Whenever you take a Reveal turn, opponents gain if you have no Agents on board spaces new to Rise of Ix.
en_US.scenario.IxianEngineering.name: Ixian Engineering
en_US.scenario.IxianEngineering.flavor: You need to drink. It's recycled water from the tent. Sweat and tears.
en_US.scenario.IxianEngineering.normal.descrip: You start with an Ixian Engineer instead of a Dune, the Desert Planet. You can’t win unless you've acquired at least 3 Techs.
en_US.scenario.IxianEngineering.heroic.descrip: You start with an Ixian Engineer instead of a Dune, the Desert Planet. You can't send Agents to board spaces that cost and you can’t win unless you've acquired at least 5 Techs.
en_US.scenario.OffworldConflict.name: Interstellar Warfare
en_US.scenario.OffworldConflict.flavor: We are the Sardaukar. The Emperor's blades. All who stand against us fall.
en_US.scenario.OffworldConflict.normal.descrip: The Shipping and Ix board spaces are Combat spaces.
en_US.scenario.OffworldConflict.heroic.descrip: The Shipping and Ix board spaces are Combat spaces. Maker spaces are not Combat spaces. Opponents start with 2 Spacing Guild Influence.
en_US.scenario.AdvancedTech.name: Advanced Tech
en_US.scenario.AdvancedTech.flavor: It's a Fremkit. Fremen survival gear. It will give us a chance.
en_US.scenario.AdvancedTech.normal.description: You start with Holoprojectors in play. Opponents start with Holtzman Engine.
en_US.scenario.AdvancedTech.heroic.description: You start with Holoprojectors in play. Opponents start with Holtzman Engine and one The Spice Must Flow.
en_US.scenario.DoubleAgents.name: Double Agents
en_US.scenario.DoubleAgents.flavor: You want absolution? Go catch some spies!
en_US.scenario.DoubleAgents.normal.description: The Imperium deck contains an additional copy of each card with an infiltration Agent icon. You start with a Bounty Hunter instead of a Reconnaissance. Whenever a player sends an Agent to a board space with an enemy Agent, they acquire a copy of the last card that Agent's Leader acquired.
en_US.scenario.DoubleAgents.heroic.description: The Imperium deck contains an additional copy of each card with an infiltration Agent icon. You start with a Court Intrigue instead of a Seek Allies. Whenever a player sends an Agent to a board space with an enemy Agent, they acquire a copy of the last card that Agent's Leader acquired. Opponents start with a seat on the High Council.
en_US.scenario.FinalDelivery.name: Final Delivery
en_US.scenario.FinalDelivery.flavor: You know what will happen if I don't get spice production back on track.
en_US.scenario.FinalDelivery.normal.descriptio: Your Leader is Yuna Moritani. You start with a Local Fence on the bottom of your deck. You can’t win unless you make 2 “Final Deliveries” (Yuna’s Signet ability).
en_US.scenario.FinalDelivery.heroic.descriptio: Your Leader is Yuna Moritani. You start with a CHOAM Delegate on the bottom of your deck. You can’t win unless you make 3 “Final Deliveries” (Yuna’s Signet ability).
en_US.scenario.Snooping.name: Snooping
en_US.scenario.Snooping.flavor: I secured a copy of the Harkonnens' account books.
en_US.scenario.Snooping.normal.description:
Your Leader is Tessia Vernius. You start with Web of Power in your discard pile and no Diplomacy.
Snooper tokens start one space higher on each Influence track. You can’t win unless you reach each Snooper token.
en_US.scenario.Snooping.heroic.description: Your Leader is Tessia Vernius. You start with Quid Pro Quo and an extra Reconnaissance instead of a Signet Ring. Snooper tokens start one space higher on each Influence track. You can’t win unless you reach each Snooper token.
en_US.scenario.OverpoweringDread.name: Overpowering Dread
en_US.scenario.OverpoweringDread.flavor: You've never met Harkonnens before. I have. They're not human. They're brutal!
en_US.scenario.OverpoweringDread.normal.descri: At the start of Combat, each player with a deployed dreadnought draws a random Combat Intrigue card. Whenever an opponent gains their Swordmaster, they commission a dreadnought.
en_US.scenario.OverpoweringDread.heroic.descri: At the start of Combat, each player with a deployed dreadnought draws a random Combat Intrigue card. Your opponents start with a dreadnought.
en_US.scenario.NeutralShippingConglomerate.fla: The Harkonnens took ten billion Solaris out of here every year.
en_US.scenario.NeutralShippingConglomerate.nor: When you recall your Freighter from the top of the Shipping track, gain 1 <sprite name="VictoryPoint">. You can’t gain Faction Alliances.
en_US.scenario.NeutralShippingConglomerate.her:
When you recall your Freighter from the top of the Shipping track, gain 1 .
You can’t gain Faction Alliances. You can’t gain from Conflicts unless you have a dreadnought deployed.
en_US.scenario.AnEpicConclusion.name: An Epic Conclusion
en_US.scenario.AnEpicConclusion.normal.descrip: You play the game using Epic Mode rules. Opponents start with their Freighter at the top of the Shipping track and 1 <sprite name="VictoryPoint">.
en_US.scenario.AnEpicConclusion.heroic.descrip: You play the game using Epic Mode rules. Opponents start with their Freighter at the top of the Shipping track and 3 <sprite name="VictoryPoint">.
en_US.scenario.BlankSlate.name: Blank Slate
en_US.scenario.BlankSlate.normal.description: You have no Leader and start with a Blank Slate instead of Diplomacy and Signet Ring.
en_US.scenario.BlankSlate.flavor: Seek freedom and become captive of your desires. Seek discipline and find your liberty.
en_US.scenario.BlankSlate.heroic.description:
You have no Leader and start with no and with a Blank Slate instead of Diplomacy and Signet Ring.
Opponents start with an extra Signet Ring.
en_US.scenario.PrepareForTheStorm.name: Prepare for the Storm
en_US.scenario.PrepareForTheStorm.normal.descr:
At the start of the game, each player drafts a , , , and cost card to replace Seek Allies, Convincing Argument, Dagger, and Experimentation.
Skirmish is removed from the Conflict deck.
en_US.scenario.PrepareForTheStorm.flavor: A storm is coming. Our storm. And when it arrives, it will shake the universe.
en_US.scenario.PrepareForTheStorm.heroic.descr:
At the start of the game, each player drafts a , , , and cost card to replace Seek Allies, Convincing Argument, Dagger, and Experimentation. Opponents additionally draft a cost card to replace a Convincing Argument.
Skirmish is removed from the Conflict deck.
en_US.scenario.ClandestineMeeting.name: Clandestine Meeting
en_US.scenario.ClandestineMeeting.normal.descr: You start with Clandestine Meeting instead of Diplomacy. It will only draw Immortality Intrigue cards. Opponents start with a random Intrigue card.
en_US.scenario.ClandestineMeeting.heroic.descr:
You start with Long Reach instead of Diplomacy. It will only draw Immortality Intrigue cards.
Opponents start with Twisted Mentat instead of Dagger and two random Intrigue cards.
en_US.scenario.ResearchAssignment.name: Research Assignment
en_US.scenario.ResearchAssignment.normal.descr:
At the start of each round, a random card in your hand is earmarked for research. If you use that card to send an Agent this round, gain .
You start with one fewer Experimentation.
You can’t win unless you've unlocked .
en_US.scenario.ResearchAssignment.flavor: Science is made up of so many things that appear obvious after they are explained.
en_US.scenario.ResearchAssignment.heroic.descr:
At the start of each round, a random card in your hand is earmarked for research. If you use that card to send an Agent this round, gain .
You start with no Experimentations.
You can’t win unless you've unlocked . Opponents start with .
en_US.scenario.Resurrection.name: Resurrection
en_US.scenario.Resurrection.normal.description:
At the end of Combat, each player gains a for every two troops they had deployed (rounded down).
on the research track are replaced with troops.
en_US.scenario.Resurrection.flavor: The mystery of life isn't a problem to solve, but a reality to experience.
en_US.scenario.Resurrection.heroic.description:
At the end of Combat, each player gains a for every two troops they had deployed (rounded down).
on the research track are replaced with troops.
Opponents start with From the Tanks instead of a Dagger.
en_US.scenario.ShowOfStrength.name: Show of Strength
en_US.scenario.ShowOfStrength.normal.descripti:
Whenever a player wins a Conflict with 2+ strength more than the next highest player, they acquire a random Tleilaxu card. The greater the victory, the higher the cost the card.

• 2-3:
• 4-5:
• 6-9:
• 10+:
en_US.scenario.ShowOfStrength.flavor: You do not beg the sun for mercy.
en_US.scenario.ShowOfStrength.heroic.descripti:
Whenever a player wins a Conflict with 2+ strength more than the next highest player, they acquire a random Tleilaxu card. The greater the victory, the higher the cost the card.

Opponents start with Show of Strength instead of Reconnaissance.

• 2-3:
• 4-5:
• 6-9:
• 10+:
en_US.scenario.Bribery.name: Bribery
en_US.scenario.Bribery.normal.description:
You may pay opponents to ignore their Agents at a board space.
If a player takes their Reveal turn while having 2+ Agents on the same board spaces as enemy Agents, they gain .
You can't win unless you have reached the end of the Tleilaxu track.
en_US.scenario.Bribery.flavor: You cannot manipulate a marionette with only one string.
en_US.scenario.Bribery.heroic.description:
You may pay opponents to ignore their Agents at a board space.
If a player takes their Reveal turn while having 2+ Agents on the same board spaces as enemy Agents, they gain . Opponents start with 1 Influence with each Faction.
You can't win unless you have reached the end of the Tleilaxu track and have an Alliance.
en_US.scenario.StillsuitTesting.name: Stillsuit Testing
en_US.scenario.StillsuitTesting.normal.descrip:
The first time you spend each turn, gain back a .
At the start of Combat, lose a troop if you have more troops in the Conflict than you have water.
en_US.scenario.StillsuitTesting.flavor: A stillsuit is designed to reclaim the body's own water. You can live for weeks in the deep desert with a Fremen suit.
en_US.scenario.StillsuitTesting.heroic.descrip: At the start of Combat, lose a troop if you have more troops in the Conflict than you have water.
en_US.scenario.PerfectSpecimen.name: Perfect Specimen
en_US.scenario.PerfectSpecimen.normal.descript:
You start with 3 .
You can’t acquire cards from the Imperium or Reserve Rows with cost greater than unless you have 18+ cards in deck.
en_US.scenario.PerfectSpecimen.flavor: The Tleilaxu, it was said, could create anything - even a new species.
en_US.scenario.PerfectSpecimen.heroic.descript:
Each player starts with 3 .
You can’t acquire cards from the Imperium or Reserve Rows with cost greater than unless you have 18+ cards in deck.
en_US.scenario.NuclearMastery.name: Nuclear Mastery
en_US.scenario.NuclearMastery.normal.descripti:
When a player uses Family Atomics, they gain the acquire effect of each card discarded from the Imperium Row and the replacement cards cost less until the end of their turn.
When a player gains an Alliance, their Family Atomics is refreshed.
en_US.scenario.NuclearMastery.flavor: He who can destroy the thing has the real control of it.
en_US.scenario.NuclearMastery.heroic.descripti:
When a player uses Family Atomics, they gain the acquire effect of each card discarded from the Imperium Row and the replacement cards cost less until the end of their turn.
When a player gains an Alliance, their Family Atomics is refreshed. When an opponent gains an Alliance, they also gain a The Spice Must Flow.
Go to 11 rules are used.
en_US.scenario.FedaykinInitiation.name: Fedaykin Initiation
en_US.scenario.FedaykinInitiation.flavor: There's no finer fighter in the Imperium. They fight like demons.
en_US.scenario.FedaykinInitiation.normal.descr: Start with Maker Hooks but no troops in your garrison.
en_US.scenario.FedaykinInitiation.heroic.descr: Start with Maker Hooks but no water or troops in your garrison.\nYou can't take a seat on the High Council or acquire The Spice Must Flow.
en_US.scenario.CalloftheDesert.name: Call of the Desert
en_US.scenario.CalloftheDesert.flavor: My father came not for spice, not for riches, but for the strength of your people.
en_US.scenario.CalloftheDesert.normal.descript:
You start with Demand Attention and Desert Call instead of Diplomacy and a Dune, the Desert Planet.
Opponents start with a random cost card.\nEach player starts with a random Intrigue card.
en_US.scenario.CalloftheDesert.heroic.descript:
You start with Demand Attention and Desert Call instead of Diplomacy and a Dune, the Desert Planet.
Opponents start with a random cost card.\nYou start with a random Intrigue card and your opponents start with two.
en_US.scenario.EyesoftheImperium.name: Eyes of the Imperium
en_US.scenario.EyesoftheImperium.flavor: Like sifting sand through a screen, we sift people.
en_US.scenario.EyesoftheImperium.normal.descri: Start with a Spy.\nRound start: If you didn't send an Agent to a board space you were spying on last round, draw 1 fewer card.
en_US.scenario.EyesoftheImperium.heroic.descri: Start with a Spy.\nRound start: If you didn't send an Agent to a board space you were spying on last round, draw 2 fewer cards.
en_US.scenario.CHOAMHunter.name: CHOAM Hunter
en_US.scenario.CHOAMHunter.flavor: CHOAM directorships were the real evidence of political power in the Imperium.
en_US.scenario.CHOAMHunter.normal.description:
Round start: If you have no open contracts, take one.
At the end of each round, lose for each open contract you have.
en_US.scenario.CHOAMHunter.heroic.description:
Round start: If you have no open contracts, take one.
At the end of each round, lose for each open contract you have. If you can't, lose instead.
en_US.scenario.EmperorsMandate.name: Emperor’s Mandate
en_US.scenario.EmperorsMandate.flavor: The Emperor has given me Arrakis as my fief to rule and protect.
en_US.scenario.EmperorsMandate.normal.descript: When you reach 2 Influence with the Emperor, acquire Delivery Agreement. When you reach 4 Influence, acquire Interstellar Trade You can't win unless you've completed 4 or more contracts. Opponents start with .
en_US.scenario.EmperorsMandate.heroic.descript:
When you reach 2 Influence with the Emperor, acquire Cargo Runner.\nWhen you reach 4 Influence, acquire Priority Contracts.\nYou can't win unless you've completed 6 or more contracts.
Opponents start with .
en_US.scenario.UnrelentingBlade.name: Unrelenting Blade
en_US.scenario.UnrelentingBlade.flavor: Arrakis teaches the attitude of the knife - chopping off what's incomplete and saying: "Now, it's complete because it's ended here."
en_US.scenario.UnrelentingBlade.normal.descrip: Reveal turn: Gain for each of your unmatched battle icons.\nEndgame: Lose for each of them.
en_US.scenario.UnrelentingBlade.heroic.descrip: Reveal turn: Gain for each of your unmatched battle icons.\nEndgame: Lose for each of them.\nOpponents start with one of each standard battle icon and you start with none.
en_US.scenario.WatchersintheDark.name: Watchers in the Dark
en_US.scenario.WatchersintheDark.flavor: I trusted you completely, even when you walked in shadows.
en_US.scenario.WatchersintheDark.normal.descri:
When you recall a Spy to gather intelligence, you draw an additional card.\nYou start with Distraction.
Opponents start with .
en_US.scenario.WatchersintheDark.heroic.descri:
When you recall a Spy to gather intelligence, you draw an additional card.\nYou start with Go to Ground.
Opponents start with their Swordmasters.
en_US.scenario.HarvestingQuotas.name: Harvesting Quotas
en_US.scenario.HarvestingQuotas.flavor: Restore spice production, or you will live out your life in a pain amplifier.
en_US.scenario.HarvestingQuotas.normal.descrip:
You start with Smuggler's Harvester and Fedaykin Stilltent instead of two Dune, the Desert Planet.
Whenever you would gain spice, instead it's stockpiled and can't be spent. Whenever you have stockpiled, sell it for .
en_US.scenario.HarvestingQuotas.heroic.descrip:
You start with Smuggler's Harvester and Fedaykin Stilltent instead of Convincing Arguments.
Whenever you would gain spice, instead it's stockpiled and can't be spent. When you have stockpiled, sell it for .
en_US.scenario.BoundbytheLitany.name: Bound by the Litany
en_US.scenario.BoundbytheLitany.flavor: Hope? We are Bene Gesserit. We don't hope, we plan.
en_US.scenario.BoundbytheLitany.normal.descrip: You can't acquire more Emperor, Spacing Guild, or Fremen cards than you have Bene Gesserit cards.
en_US.scenario.BoundbytheLitany.heroic.descrip: You can't acquire more Emperor, Spacing Guild, or Fremen cards than you have Bene Gesserit cards.\nYou can't acquire more Fremen, Emperor, or Spacing Guild Influence than you have Bene Gesserit Influence.\nOpponents start with 1 Influence with each Faction except the Bene Gesserit.
en_US.scenario.Sandrider.name: Sandrider
en_US.scenario.Sandrider.flavor: I serve only one master. His name is Shai-Hulud.

en_US.events.runscomplete.description: You've completed all of your runs for this event.
en_US.event.shortdesc001: Welcome to the first Dune Event Test! In this special event players will Draft their leaders and begin the game with a random Intrigue Card.
en_US.event.desc001:
Players can play up to 4 games per run for leaderboard points. How you earn leaderboard points is as follows:

- 1st Place - 10 pts
- 2nd Place - 6 pts
- 3rd Place - 3 pts
- 4th Place - 1 pt
- Replaced by a Bot - 0 Pts

Players can enter the event in two separate "runs". In each run, the player will earn a final score towards the leaderboard. But only their highest score will count toward the final placements.

Additionally, the event has a special bonus rule, Preparation - Each player starts with a random Intrigue card.
en_US.event.shortdesc002: In this event players will Draft their leaders and at the end of each round, the player(s) with the most Solari will recruit a troop to their Garrison.
en_US.event.desc002:
Players can play up to 6 games for leaderboard points. How you earn leaderboard points is as follows:

- 1st Place - 10 pts
- 2nd Place - 6 pts
- 3rd Place - 3 pts
- 4th Place - 1 pt
- Replaced by a Bot - 0 Pts

This event has a special bonus rule, War Chest - At the end of each round, the player(s) with the most Solari will recruit a troop to their Garrison.
en_US.event.shortdesc003: Join us in celebrating the Dune Imperium full release!
en_US.event.desc003:
Players can play up to 3 games for leaderboard points. How you earn leaderboard points is as follows:

1st Place: 10 pts
2nd Place: 6 pts
3rd Place: 3 pts
4th Place: 1 pt
Replaced by a Bot: 0 Pts
en_US.prompt.ranked.title: Ranked Play
en_US.ranked.leaderboard.title: Top 100 Master Players
en_US.ranked.rankup.mastersubtitle: You will now show up on the leaderboard along with other Master players.
en_US.ranked.stars.gain.ftt: Earn 2 stars for placing 1st, 1 star for 2nd.
en_US.ranked.stars.lose.ftt: At Gold rank and above you lose 1 star for getting last place. However, losing stars will never cause you to drop a rank once you have earned it.
en_US.ranked.landing.info:
5 minutes before each half hour mark, the queue will open and allow players to join to play in the next set of games.

At each half hour, players in the queue will be seated into tables of 3 or 4 player games.

Work your way from Bronze rank all the way to Master and take your place on the top 100 leaderboard!

en_US.up.tut.intro.1: The time for revolution is now. Lead well, and be victorious!
en_US.up.tut.intro.2: I see the path. I won't fail the Fremen, Stilgar.
en_US.up.tut.intro.3: The landscape of Arrakis has changed since we last battled here. Let's take a look.
en_US.up.tut.intro.4: You'll recognize a few familiar board spaces, but most are new or changed.
en_US.up.tut.swordmaster.1: With all the conflict, Swordmasters are easier to come by.
en_US.up.tut.swordmaster.2: Now, only the first player to take one pays <sprite name="Solari_8">, while everyone else pays <sprite name="Solari_6">.
en_US.up.tut.turn1.1: Other spaces have changed entirely. Send an Agent to the new Fremen board space Fremkit to draw a card.
en_US.up.tut.turn1.2: Hold off on deploying any troops and see what the Princess tries.
en_US.up.tut.ai.turn.1: By order of the Imperial Throne, you will submit.
en_US.up.tut.turn2.1: She wants to contest me... what rewards does this Conflict bring?
en_US.up.tut.turn2.2: Take a look at the symbol in the upper corner.
en_US.up.tut.turn2.3: Each Conflict card has one of three different battle icons: , , or . Win a Conflict and, in addition to its other rewards, you gain its icon.
en_US.up.tut.turn2.4: When you collect a second battle icon of the same type, the two immediately convert into a .
en_US.up.tut.turn2.5: Each player starts with 1 random battle icon.
en_US.up.tut.turn2.6: That means it's even better to win Conflicts for battle icons I already have - and to keep my enemies from doing the same.
en_US.up.tut.turn2.7: You see clearly. Send an Agent to Arrakeen and enter the Conflict.
en_US.up.tut.turn2.8: With two Daggers, I think I can prevail with just two troops.
en_US.up.tut.turn2.9: The desert belongs to the Fremen!
en_US.up.tut.turn3.1: You'll notice that many new cards feature the Spy icon.
en_US.up.tut.turn3.2: It looks like this card will give me a Spy as soon as I take it.
en_US.up.tut.turn3.3: A good idea. Acquire Spy Network now.
en_US.up.tut.turn3.4: Spies are placed at one of the observation posts around the board.
en_US.up.tut.turn3.5: Place your Spy on Hagga Basin's observation post - I have a feeling it may be useful later.
en_US.up.tut.turn3.6: I see there's a new Reserve card available. Examine it.
en_US.up.tut.turn3.7: Prepare the Way gets stronger when you're in good standing with the Bene Gesserit.
en_US.up.tut.turn3.8: Acquire a Prepare the Way and end your turn.
en_US.up.tut.turn3.conflict.1: The Conflict is yours, including its battle icon.
en_US.up.tut.turn3.conflict.2: Improve your Influence with the Fremen.
en_US.up.tut.turn4.1: In Uprising, you have the opportunity to take and complete contracts. This could be a great help to the war effort.
en_US.up.tut.turn4.2: There are two new board spaces where you can find them reliably: Accept Contract and Dutiful Service.
en_US.up.tut.turn4.3: I'll send an Agent to Accept Contract to pursue this.
en_US.up.tut.turn4.4: Draw a card for your Signet Ring, then select the contract ability.
en_US.up.tut.turn4.5: Whenever you gain a <sprite name="Contract"> contract, you may take one of the two available.
en_US.up.tut.turn4.6: Most contracts require you to send an Agent to a certain board space, at which point the contract is complete and you gain its benefits.
en_US.up.tut.turn4.8: You can see the contracts you have near your resources. The first number is contracts you haven't completed - the second is those you have.
en_US.up.tut.turn5.1: You'll need help to repel the Princess's forces. Now that you have 2 Influence with the Fremen, send an Agent to Sietch Tabr.
en_US.up.tut.turn5.2: Sietch Tabr is different than I remember. Now I have two options.
en_US.up.tut.turn5.3: The first time you visit Sietch Tabr you should choose the first option. I'll show you what the second is for later.
en_US.up.tut.turn5.4: In addition to a water and a troop, at Sietch Tabr you can now gain Maker Hooks. With these, you'll be able to ride mighty sandworms into battle!
en_US.up.tut.turn5.5: For now, deploy troops as you wish and end your turn.
en_US.up.tut.turn6.1: Acquire cards and end your turn.
en_US.up.tut.turn7.2: Place your Spy at any observation post.
en_US.up.tut.turn7.3: Something to keep in mind: certain effects will reward you for having completed contracts.
en_US.up.tut.turn7.4: Conserve your troops for now - I have a plan.
en_US.up.tut.turn8.1: Now that you have Maker Hooks, you have access to sandworms. These powerful units can be summoned at Deep Desert and Hagga Basin.
en_US.up.tut.turn8.2: I don't have enough water to send an Agent to the Deep Desert, and Princess Irulan just blocked Hagga Basin with her Agent!
en_US.up.tut.turn8.3: True, but the Spy you placed earlier can help - you can ignore enemy Agents at a board space by recalling (spending) a Spy connected to that space.
en_US.up.tut.turn8.4: When you send an Agent to a sandworm space, you choose: take the base spice for that space or summon a sandworm - two sandworms, in the case of Deep Desert.
en_US.up.tut.turn8.5: Normally you would also get any bonus spice here (for either choice) but the Princess beat you to it this round. Summon a sandworm.
en_US.up.tut.turn8.6: Sandworms are 3 <sprite name="strength"> units, so they hit hard. They're also immediately deployed and can't ever be retreated.
en_US.up.tut.turn8.7: However, their true power comes from their effect on Combat rewards.
en_US.up.tut.turn8.8: For all Conflicts in which you have a sandworm (or more than 1), the rewards you gain from that Conflict are doubled.
en_US.up.tut.turn8.9: This doesn't include battle icons, however, which are always one per Conflict.
en_US.up.tut.turn8.10: With double rewards on the line, I'll send 2 troops along with the sandworm and teach Her Highness the meaning of desert power.
en_US.up.tut.ai.turn8: Irulan just used another ability of Spies: Gather Intelligence. Whenever you send an Agent to a board space you're spying on, you can recall that Spy to draw a card.
en_US.up.tut.turn9.1: That's right. Thanks to the chaos that sandworm created, my Unpredictable Foe ability is finally active.
en_US.up.tut.turn9.2: You also revealed Spy Network, but don't have 2 Spies on the board to be able to use its effect.
en_US.up.tut.turn9.3: From this point on, make your own choices and demonstrate what you've learned.
en_US.up.tut.turn9.conflict.1: You won! Thanks to your sandworm, your rewards are doubled.
en_US.up.tut.turn9.conflict.2: The battle icon you gained doesn't get doubled, but since you already had a matching one, they'll combine into an immediate Victory Point.
en_US.up.tut.turn10.2: Its orange color and the icon on the bottom indicate that this Conflict takes place behind the Shield Wall, a mountain range which protects the cities of Arrakis.
en_US.up.tut.turn10.3: Sandworms can't get past the Shield Wall, so they can't be deployed to Conflicts like this while the Shield Wall is intact.
en_US.up.tut.turn10.4: However, if the Shield Wall is destroyed, sandworms can be used in these Conflicts normally for the rest of the game.
en_US.up.tut.turn10.5: You've already seen one method of doing so - Sietch Tabr.
en_US.up.tut.victory: I knew you would prevail. We're on our way to winning this war.
en_US.up.tut.turn2.2.gamepad: Take a look at the symbol in the upper corner.
en_US.up.tut.turn3.6.gamepad: I see there's a new Reserve card available. Examine it.
en_US.up.tut.turn7.0: This icon indicates that there's a contract you can complete by sending an Agent to Arrakeen.
en_US.up.tut.turn7.1b: You've satisfied your contract and may collect your rewards.
en_US.up.tut.turn7.3.gamepad: Something to keep in mind: certain effects will reward you for having completed contracts.
en_US.up.tut.turn9.0b: I see you've developed some new skills.
